snip.t: A 45‑year‑old man with recurrent UTIs is found to have a 6 mm distal ureteric stone causing obstruction.

Renal and ureteric stones predominate in developed countries; bladder stones are commoner in the developing world (dehydration, urinary infection, poor diet in children, and outflow obstruction in men).

snip.t: Severe colicky flank pain with haematuria is the classic presentation of renal/ureteric stones causing obstruction and mucosal trauma.
